targets.rawSql: SELECT now() AS t, 'пассажиров/мин' AS metric, round(sum(passengers) / 5.0, 0) AS value FROM metro.station_load_1m WHERE direction = 'in' AND minute > (SELECT max(minute) FROM metro.station_load_1m) - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE
SELECT count() AS "событий" FROM metro.turnstile_events_all WHERE event_date = today()

panels.title: Сверка слоёв: сырые минус агрегаты (должно быть 0)

targets.rawSql: SELECT (SELECT count() FROM metro.turnstile_events_all) - (SELECT toUInt64(sum(passengers)) FROM metro.station_load_1m) AS "расхождение"

WITH m AS (SELECT train_id, minute, sum(delta) AS d FROM metro.train_load_1m GROUP BY train_id, minute), r AS (SELECT train_id, minute, sum(d) OVER (PARTITION BY train_id ORDER BY minute ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS onboard FROM m) SELECT max(onboard / cap) AS "LF" FROM r INNER JOIN (SELECT train_id, num_cars * total_per_car AS cap FROM metro.trains) AS tr USING (train_id) WHERE minute > (SELECT max(minute) FROM metro.train_load_1m) - INTERVAL 1 HOUR

WITH cur AS (SELECT station_id, sum(passengers) AS passengers FROM metro.station_load_1m WHERE minute > (SELECT max(minute) FROM metro.station_load_1m) - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY station_id) SELECT dictGet('metro.dict_stations', 'lat', cur.station_id) AS latitude, dictGet('metro.dict_stations', 'lon', cur.station_id) AS longitude, dictGet('metro.dict_stations', 'name', cur.station_id) AS name, cur.passengers AS "пассажиров" FROM cur

WITH cur AS (SELECT station_id, sum(passengers) AS passengers FROM metro.station_load_1m WHERE minute > (SELECT max(minute) FROM metro.station_load_1m) - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY station_id) SELECT dictGet('metro.dict_stations', 'name', cur.station_id) AS "станция", cur.passengers AS "пассажиров" FROM cur ORDER BY passengers DESC LIMIT 12

panels.title: Поток по станциям (входы, топ-8 за диапазон)

targets.rawSql: SELECT minute AS t, concat(dictGet('metro.dict_stations', 'name', station_id), ' (вход)') AS metric, sum(passengers) AS value FROM metro.station_load_1m WHERE direction = 'in' AND $__timeFilter(minute) AND station_id GLOBAL IN (SELECT station_id FROM metro.station_load_1m WHERE direction = 'in' AND $__timeFilter(minute) GROUP BY station_id ORDER BY sum(passengers) DESC LIMIT 8) GROUP BY t, metric ORDER BY t

SELECT minute AS t, concat(dictGet('metro.dict_lines', 'name', line_id), ' / ', if(direction = 'in', 'вход', 'выход')) AS metric, sum(passengers) AS value FROM metro.line_load_1m WHERE $__timeFilter(minute) GROUP BY t, metric ORDER BY t

WITH m AS (SELECT train_id, minute, sum(delta) AS d FROM metro.train_load_1m GROUP BY train_id, minute), r AS (SELECT train_id, minute, sum(d) OVER (PARTITION BY train_id ORDER BY minute ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS onboard FROM m), last10 AS (SELECT train_id, max_by(onboard, minute) AS onboard FROM r WHERE minute > (SELECT max(minute) FROM metro.train_load_1m) - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE GROUP BY train_id) SELECT toString(last10.train_id) AS "поезд", dictGet('metro.dict_lines', 'name', toUInt16(intDiv(last10.train_id, 10000))) AS "линия", t.num_cars AS "вагонов", t.total_per_car AS "в вагоне", last10.onboard AS "на борту", round(last10.onboard / (t.num_cars * t.total_per_car), 3) AS LF FROM last10 INNER JOIN (SELECT train_id, any(num_cars) AS num_cars, any(total_per_car) AS total_per_car FROM metro.trains GROUP BY train_id) AS t USING (train_id) ORDER BY LF DESC LIMIT 15
